text:
No dataset in this output shows forest on the property in 2020. The JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (V4) map is the 2020 forest reference, and it reports 0.0 ha of forest (0% of the asset) in 2020.

The only evidence of earlier tree cover comes from Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13). It shows 23.0 ha of tree cover in 2000 (≥30% canopy). It also records loss events in 2008, 2015, 2017 and 2020 (67.7 ha in 2020 alone). That is history, not a 2020 forest status.

Hansen's loss data therefore suggests trees existed before 2020, but the 2020 reference map does not show forest at the end of that year.

For the post-2020 period, no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected from 2021 to 2025. This is not a compliance finding.
